tasks.title: Signal Drift
tasks.summary: Pilot a courier craft through a storm-damaged relay field, restore three gates, and reach extraction.
tasks.summaryZh: 驾驶一艘小型信使飞船穿越风暴损毁的空中中继区，依次修复三座中继门，维持飞船能量，避开移动障碍，最后穿过撤离环完成任务。

evaluation.objective: Restore all three relay gates in order, keep enough charge to stay airborne, then cross the extraction ring.
evaluation.objectiveZh: 按顺序修复全部三座中继门，在飞行中收集并维持足够能量，最后穿过撤离环。
evaluation.controls: Each build must explain its own desktop keyboard controls and provide usable pointer or touch controls on mobile.
evaluation.controlsZh: 每个版本都应在游戏内说明自己的桌面键盘操作，并在手机上提供可用的指针或触摸操作。

checklist.text: A clear start screen explains the setting, objective, and how to begin.
checklist.textZh: 开始画面清楚交代背景、目标和进入游戏的方法。

checklist.text: Steering, forward motion, collisions, charge management, and ordered relay progress form a coherent playable loop.
checklist.textZh: 转向、前进、碰撞、能量管理和按顺序修复中继门组成完整可玩的循环。

checklist.text: The course is spatially legible, with convincing speed, turning, impact, danger, and success feedback.
checklist.textZh: 航线在空间上容易辨认，并能明确反馈速度、转向、撞击、危险和成功。

checklist.text: The HUD shows charge, relay progress, and the current objective without blocking the playfield.
checklist.textZh: HUD 显示能量、中继修复进度和当前目标，同时不遮挡主要游戏区域。

checklist.text: Victory, failure, pause, restart, desktop controls, and mobile controls all work reliably.
checklist.textZh: 胜利、失败、暂停、重新开始、桌面操作和手机操作都能可靠工作。
